answer: New participants also need a jade voucher signed by three distinct established peers, and vouchers decay unless renewed by real work. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond locked to a unique hardware root; duplicate identities cannot reuse the same key without forfeiting the bond. An attacker flooding fake identities must acquire scarce jade endorsements and lock real copper per identity, making a sybil swarm cost more than the ocean of rewards it could capture. From sa0028's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
